MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Carole King and Jim Croce feel like natural next choices because I am drawn to warm melodies and personal storytelling, consistent with my interest in Jonathan Edwards and Melanie.",
    "The Mamas & the Papas fit the vocal harmonies and mid-sixties sound I have enjoyed through Simon & Garfunkel and AM Gold."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Simon & Garfunkel collection matches my taste but feels redundant because I already have a best-of collection and expect overlapping songs.",
    "Styx fits my broader classic rock listening, but I want softer songs right now. Bread, Gordon Lightfoot and the Eagles appeal to me too, yet are less compelling than today's three choices.",
    "I cannot judge Ha The Definitive or Greatest Hits confidently because I cannot identify the artists from those titles. My hesitation is uncertainty, rather than a clear dislike of their music."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My frequent interest in greatest-hits collections seems to have been taken as a reason to offer more of them, even when the songs may duplicate music I already have.",
    "My older rock listening seems to have been treated broadly, although familiar era alone does not capture the warmth, harmonies and storytelling I want today."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My preference today is for gentle, melodic songs with expressive vocals or acoustic storytelling, which makes Carole King, the Mamas & the Papas and Jim Croce especially appealing.",
    "Enjoying an artist does not mean I want another overlapping collection; I want a meaningful addition to my listening.",
    "I choose selectively: several albums can suit my taste without being something I would pick on this visit."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You understood my interest in melodic older music, but gave too much weight to familiar artists and greatest-hits collections compared with my current mood and desire for something I do not already have."
